avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Vitamin D (>4000 IU daily without monitoring)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Concurrent use may cause hypercalcemia; teriparatide increases serum calcium and vitamin D enhances intestinal calcium absorption
avoid_supplements.action: Monitor serum calcium levels closely; coordinate vitamin D dosing with prescriber; limit to recommended dietary intake unless supervised

avoid_supplements.name: Phosphate binders (Calcium carbonate >2000mg daily)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Excessive supplemental calcium may interfere with teriparatide's calcium-mobilizing effects and alter PTH-mediated phosphate regulation
avoid_supplements.action: Use minimal supplemental calcium; obtain baseline serum calcium and phosphate; coordinate with prescriber

caution_supplements.name: Magnesium supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Magnesium affects PTH secretion and calcium absorption; excessive supplementation may attenuate teriparatide response
caution_supplements.action: Maintain normal magnesium intake; monitor serum magnesium if supplementing

caution_supplements.name: Strontium supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Both agents promote bone formation; additive effects possible with unclear long-term safety profile
caution_supplements.action: Consider temporal separation of administration; discuss concurrent use with prescriber

avoid_foods.name: High dietary phosphate (processed meats, soft drinks, cheese >1500mg daily)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Excessive phosphate intake suppresses PTH secretion and may counteract teriparatide's bone-anabolic effects
avoid_foods.action: Counsel on modest phosphate restriction; encourage whole foods over processed items

caution_foods.name: High-calcium dairy (>1200mg daily from foods alone)
caution_foods.mechanism: May contribute to hypercalcemia risk when combined with teriparatide's calcium-mobilizing effects
caution_foods.action: Monitor total dietary calcium intake; ensure combined intake does not exceed recommended limits

caution_foods.name: Caffeine-rich beverages (>400mg daily)
caution_foods.mechanism: Caffeine increases urinary calcium excretion and may modestly reduce teriparatide efficacy
caution_foods.action: Encourage moderate caffeine consumption; counsel on balanced fluid intake

monitoring_notes: Monitor serum calcium, phosphate, and alkaline phosphatase at baseline and periodically during therapy; assess for hypercalcemia symptoms (nausea, constipation, polyuria). Ensure adequate vitamin D levels (25-75 ng/mL) and coordinate supplementation with prescriber to prevent overcorrection.
